owner_posts.post_text:
The Complete Mumbai Pest Control Guide — Monsoon 2025
Mumbai residents ask us the same questions every monsoon season. Here are the most important answers — from 48 years of pest control experience in Mumbai. 🌧️

❓ Which pests are most common in Mumbai during monsoon?
